scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='frontend/.next';if(!fs.existsSync(src)){throw new Error('frontend/.next not found after build')}fs.rmSync('.next',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(src,'.next',{recursive:true});console.log('Copied frontend/.next -> .next')"
